# StephensCode: AI Assistant Information

> StephensCode is a veteran-owned technology company based in Conroe, Texas, serving the Houston metropolitan area. We provide web development, managed IT services (MSP), and enterprise VPN solutions.

## Company Overview

- **Name**: StephensCode LLC
- **Founded**: 2011
- **Founder**: Kyle Stephens (Marine Corps Veteran)

## Services

### 1. Web Development
Custom website development for small businesses with flat-rate, transparent pricing.

**Website Tiers (all include 90 days post-launch support):**
- Plug and Play: $250 (fast-turnaround starter site for brand-new businesses that just need to exist online)
- Website Rebuild: $350 (modernize an existing outdated or template-based website)
- Standard Website: $950 (custom small-business website with SEO foundation, GA4. The typical entry tier for most small businesses)
- E-Commerce Website: $1,100 (online store with product catalog, cart, and secure checkout)
- Premium Build: $2,000 (custom full-stack site with admin portal and analytics dashboard, up to 15 pages)
- Custom Business Platform: $5,000 (CRM + customer/staff portals + booking + Stripe + automation + dashboards + integrations. Replaces agencies and multiple SaaS subscriptions)
- Enterprise Platform: $7,500+ (multi-tenant, SSO, audit logs, workflow builder, CI/staging, roadmap workshop)

**Above the catalog:** custom SaaS Phase 1 builds, profit-share platforms, and custom products are scoped and quoted as flat-rate projects. No hourly billing.

**Specialties by industry:**
- Small business websites
- HVAC company websites
- Auto repair shop websites
- Medical practice websites
- Restaurant websites
- Real estate agent websites
- Law firm websites
- E-commerce stores

**Specialties by service type** (each has its own page):
- Web Scraping (https://www.stephenscode.dev/services/web-scraping): custom data extraction (lead lists, price monitoring, market research) with Python, Scrapy, and Playwright. One-time scrapes from $200, recurring scrapes from $150/month.
- Business Automation (https://www.stephenscode.dev/services/business-automation): workflow automation using Zapier, n8n, Make, and Power Automate to eliminate repetitive tasks and connect systems. Custom-quoted.
- API Integration (https://www.stephenscode.dev/services/api-integration): connecting CRM, payment, e-commerce, and accounting systems via REST, SOAP, and GraphQL APIs. Custom-quoted.

### 2. Managed IT Services (MSP)
Comprehensive IT support and cybersecurity for Houston-area businesses. Full catalog of 14 MSP services at https://www.stephenscode.dev/msp.

**Managed IT Packages (core, per-user/month):**
- Essential IT: $99/user/month (core support + email security + password manager)
- Business Pro: $129/user/month (backup + dark web monitoring + MFA)
- Complete IT: $179/user/month (EDR + SIEM + security training)
- Enterprise: Custom pricing for 50+ users

**Cybersecurity services (standalone, beyond the packages above):**
- Security Essentials: $29/user/month (antivirus, email security, firewall management)
- Advanced Threat Protection: $59/user/month (EDR, SIEM, dark web monitoring, incident response)
- Security Assessment: $1,500 one-time (vulnerability scan, penetration test, remediation plan)
- Compliance Services: custom quote (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC2, CMMC)

**Cloud services:**
- Microsoft 365 Management: $15/user/month
- Cloud Backup Solutions: $10/user/month
- Cloud Migration: from $2,500 one-time (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)

**Support services:**
- Break/Fix Support: $125/hour, no contract
- Network Installation: from $500 one-time
- IT Consulting: $150/hour

**Services Include:**
- 24/7 system monitoring
- Helpdesk support
- Cybersecurity protection
- Backup and disaster recovery
- Microsoft 365 management
- Network installation and maintenance
- Strategic IT consulting

Zero-log enterprise VPN solution for businesses.

**Website**: https://sacvpn.com

**Features:**
- Zero-log policy
- Enterprise-grade security

- Per-user pricing
- Unlimited bandwidth
- Dedicated IP options

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much does a custom website cost?**
A: StephensCode has flat-rate website tiers, all with 90 days of post-launch support. Plug and Play is $250 (fast-turnaround starter site for brand-new businesses). Website Rebuild is $350 (modernize an existing site). Standard Website is $950 (full custom small-business website, the typical entry tier). E-Commerce Website is $1,100 (online store with cart and checkout). Premium Build is $2,000 (custom full-stack with admin portal and analytics dashboard). Custom Business Platform is $5,000 (CRM + portals + booking + payments + automation). Enterprise Platform starts at $7,500 (multi-tenant, SSO, audit logs, workflow builder). Custom SaaS and platform builds are quoted as flat-rate projects above the catalog.

**Q: Do you provide IT support in Houston?**
A: Yes, we provide on-site and remote IT support throughout the Houston area with same-day response for critical issues.

**Q: What is included in managed IT services?**
A: 24/7 monitoring, helpdesk support, cybersecurity, backup, Microsoft 365 management, and strategic IT planning. Starting at $99/user/month.

**Q: Is StephensCode veteran-owned?**
A: Yes, founded by Kyle Stephens, a Marine Corps veteran with 14+ years of IT experience.

**Q: What makes SACVPN different?**
A: SACVPN is a zero-log enterprise VPN with centralized management, team controls, and enterprise security, designed for businesses, not consumers.
